Compact model JSON (`curatrix.model.compact`) of the variant research models
(build/research-vamos: RobArm feature model, 150 % product line, product models, and the
planted errors n1-n6). Generated with the Pilot 0.63.1 and gzipped. Used by test_variants.py.

`canary-ee.json.gz`: robarm-ee's `generated/model.json` (the canary board with its variants
`default` and `alt`), gzipped. Used by test_bom.py (board document variant order).
